caption: Opening film: cranes and workers in two U.S. Navy shipyards.
description: A silent film of five shots. The gray side of a warship rises overhead against a cloudy sky. A dockside crane carries a submarine bow plane while a rigger below holds its tag line. A worker on scaffolding keeps a gloved hand on the hanging plane. An overhead crane carries a long lifting beam hung with magnets above stacks of steel plate. Sparks fly from a torch cutting steel. None of these shots show HOIST.
